steps.content: This time, to your great surprise, the Public Security Bureau has sent a pile of "household items" as opposed to the usual towering stack of paperwork.
Rice cookers, hair dryers... Why is this coffee machine constantly pumping water? And this office chair, it's not mine, is it?

One must admit, this office chair looks quite soft and comfy. It perfectly meets all the ergonomic requirements of a modern furniture piece. However, just as you're about to touch the armrest, Nightingale stops you in terror.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, please be careful! This chair will electrocute the sitter.
...Electrocute?
You find it hard to believe your own ears.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. These are household items that have recently become popular in the market, but they all have functional issues. For the specifics, please look at the report sent by the Public Security Bureau.

You take the report and open it. The first line that catches your eye is a warning from the Public Security Bureau: "Do not touch the following items. Risks of electric shock, injury from shooting, etc."

You frown and continue reading. The descriptions of the specific details are even more bizarre: when heated to 65 degrees, the lid of the rice cooker will automatically pop open and spray out rice at high speeds; even when set to cool, the hair dryer will suddenly spout fire...
...Are these really household items? They all seem like weapons, don't they?
As you gaze at the dangerous items scattered on the floor, a vague thought pops into your mind: these outrageous "features" and offbeat modifications remind you of a certain "inventor" in the Bureau.

options: Ask Nightingale about Eureka's recent activities

choices.text: Ask Nightingale about Eureka's recent activities

steps.content: Nightingale, do you know what Eureka has been up to recently?
When you mention this name, a hint of exasperation flashes in Nightingale's eyes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Eureka is researching how to modify shoe soles into surfboards, and then plans to promote their usage across the Bureau.

Surfboard shoe soles... Eureka does always come up with some incomprehensible oddities, but she has never had any ill intentions. These dangerous products are unlikely to be her work. However, her abilities and experiences may offer some help.
...In that case, please prepare the interrogation room for me and notify Eureka to come over. I have some questions to ask her.

When you enter the interrogation room, Eureka is already there. She sits on the interrogation chair, twiddling her fingers, looking somewhat uneasy and tense. In order to calm her down, you decide to start with some trivial topics.

options: Ask about the progress of her inventions

choices.text: Ask about the progress of her inventions

steps.content: Eureka, how is the research on your surfboard shoe soles coming along?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Oh, there's been progress! Based on my observations, each staff member at the Bureau walks at different speeds, so I plan to add a speed control system. This way, the soles can match different speeds and are less likely to cause collisions...
As you expected, you flipped a switch by mentioning her "specialty." Eureka immediately relaxes and starts to enthusiastically introduce her new invention.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I also consulted Miss Labyrinth. She was very... friendly, and talked to me about many mechanical principles, as well as her operating methods... uh, I also tried to make a mini-Labyrinth based on what she said, but...
Clack, clack, clack!
A strange knocking sound suddenly rings out. Following the source of the sound, you see Eureka hurriedly stuffing a palm-sized metal robot into her tool bag.
The little robot seems to be deliberately defying Eureka. As soon as she presses it down, it immediately pops its head out again.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Don't, don't worry, I'll get it to quiet down... Ah!
The little robot jumps onto Eureka's head, grabbing her hair and pulling it from side to side, laughing squeakily.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Don't do that! Mini-Lab... Ah! Chief, watch out! It's coming for you!
After a chaotic chase, Eureka finally catches the little robot. She presses a screw on its back, and everything becomes quiet again.
Eureka sits back down on the chair, scratching her head awkwardly with an apologetic smile.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Ch-Chief, I'm sorry. Mini-Laby is still in its testing phase. There are some small functional issues. I promise to fix it...
Seeing her like this, you can't bring yourself to scold her. You replace the reprimand on the tip of your tongue with a sigh.
...Let's talk about the matter at hand. The reason I summoned you is because I want you to take a look at these.
You point at the household items piled at her feet. She seems to finally notice their existence, and curiously picks up a small coffee pot.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: They connected the power cord to the grinder... Hmm, this might actually generate a reverse power flow when activated. A very interesting way of generating electricity!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: This home audio speaker has twenty-two built-in amplifiers! If turned on, it will probably blow the decibel meter. If there's a sudden power outage in the Bureau and we need to sound an alarm, it would definitely come in handy!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: And this, oh my goodness, who would think to equip a portable shower head with a barbecue torch? A two in one contraption! Simply genius!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...Uh, Chief? Why are you hiding so far away?
...Don't mind me, Eureka. What do you think of these things?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: They're highly eccentric, but very creative designs. Chief, do you know who invented these? If possible, could I... I think we would have a lot to chat about.
Unfortunately, if we find this inventor, we'd probably have to interrogate him or her at the Bureau right away.
test

These are no ordinary inventions, Eureka. Over a hundred civilians have been injured by them, some even critically. Some of the victims are still in the hospital fighting for their lives.
As if remembering something, Eureka becomes visibly uneasy. She nervously twiddles her fingers.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Chief, I'm sorry... I didn't know they hurt so many people... But I promise, I didn't do this, and I have no knowledge of it...
Her eyes are a bit frantic. After looking around, her gaze settles on a dangerous electrical appliance at her feet.
As if making up her mind, she takes a deep breath, picks up a small electric kettle, and places it on her lap.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I... I want to help you, Chief. If you need me to, I can start disassembling these devices right now. Maybe there are clues inside!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...Can I help? Even though I don't know much about investigating, I'm pretty good at dismantling machinery...
Of course, Eureka. That's why I brought you here.
Eureka nods, squats down again, and gathers the items around her. She takes a tool out of her tool bag and starts to proficiently disassemble them.
This is your first time watching Eureka work up close. To avoid being disturbed, her workshop is located in a secluded area where few people pass by.

So when you see Eureka effortlessly dismantle the rice cooker that the report described as "an intricately modified and dangerous device that will attack at the slightest trigger" as she mutters to herself, you can't help but feel amazed.
Eureka doesn't seem to be just a maker of small, trivial inventions like she presents herself. Her thinking is quirky, and her behavior is unconventional. It's clear that she has more secrets.
Seems like a great inventor not only needs to be able to create, but also to dismantle other people's creations.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Mmm, only by taking them apart can you understand how others think. One can learn a lot this way. Besides...
Eureka wipes the sweat on her forehead with an awkward smile.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I'm not a great inventor, and have nothing to show off.
But I think you're amazing, Eureka. Not only can you invent those interesting little things, but you also understand these potentially lethal "weapons" very well.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Hey!
Eureka's screwdriver falls to the ground with a clatter. She hastily picks up the tool, but accidentally knocks over the coffee machine next to her. She stands up in panic amidst the scattered parts.
You shake your head and reach out to pick up the coffee machine.
I mean no harm, Eureka. I think you know that you're a trusted friend to me. So, can you tell me more about your connection to this incident?
Eureka fiddles with her tool bag, folding and unfolding the strap a few times. With a soft sigh, she begins to spill the beans:

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I was once... tricked by someone into joining a factory, where I invented many things that they claimed were all put into use. But it was also there that I accidentally got contaminated by Mania-laced mechanical material, which awakened my power.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: After my awakening, I realized that it wasn't an ordinary factory, but an illegal one that secretly produced highly lethal weapons. My inventions were also taken by them to be modified into...
Weapons?
Eureka nods stiffly. Clearly, even though this happened a long time ago, she still finds it hard to accept that her hard work has been turned into something that could harm others.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I, I was so angry and scared at the time that I couldn't control my power... By the time I came back to my senses, the factory had blown up. I fled and started roaming around... until I found that interesting toy factory by the Rust.
Do you still remember the person who tricked you?
Eureka purses her lips and avoids your gaze, seeming to not want to elaborate on this topic.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Uh, sorry, I don't really remember. Anyway, it was that person, that person, she...
Beep...
The conversation is interrupted by a sudden noise. You and Eureka both look down at the source of the sound.
Underneath the dismantled electric kettle that just had its heater removed, a bomb is lying quietly beneath the metal wire mesh, flashing an eerie light.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Oh no! Someone just activated this bomb!
Eureka exclaims this as she quickly pulls out a palm-sized object from her pocket and throws it to the ground.

steps.speaker: Mini Robot
steps.content: Clack! Clack clack!
A dazzling white light forms a force field around you just as the explosion goes off!

The ground shakes, and many devices in the interrogation room are destroyed. Coughing non-stop, Eureka feels around the ground with her hands. After the smoke clears, you see a mini robot in her hand... the same "failed" invention that caused havoc in the interrogation room earlier.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Cough... Let me check that bomb first... cough, cough...
Having just escaped from the explosion, Eureka is still in shock. She trembles as she gathers the bomb remnants and takes out a small device.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The infection rate has exceeded the threshold. I recognize this Mania... it's from that factory I was at! All their raw materials were stained with this kind of Mania! I remember!
You gently press Eureka's wrist, trying to soothe her panic.
Eureka, look at this. Is this letter "J" also a special mark of the factory?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, this isn't a mark of the factory. This is... this is...
Eureka lifts up her head, her face covered in grime. She closes her eyes for a moment, as if making some sort of resolution, then says to you:

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: It stands for Jessie. She was once my best friend, and the one who took me to the factory.
